resources.title: Official SAT Practice (Khan Academy)
resources.description: Full-length practice and skill drills built with College Board. Khan Academy content is published under CC BY-NC-SA.

resources.title: Bluebook: digital test app
resources.description: The official application used on test day. Install it to rehearse the exact digital test interface.

resources.title: The SAT: structure, timing and scoring
resources.description: Official overview of the digital SAT: the two sections, module timing, adaptive second modules and how the 400-1600 total is built. Start here for the shape of the test.

resources.title: PSAT/NMSQT: what is on the test
resources.description: Official breakdown of the PSAT/NMSQT reading, writing and math content, including how it differs from the SAT. The National Merit route runs through this test.

resources.title: SAT Suite Question Bank: student guide
resources.description: How to filter official SAT Suite questions by section, domain, skill and difficulty. A few thousand real items, free, with answer explanations.

resources.title: Desmos Graphing Calculator
resources.description: The same graphing calculator embedded in Bluebook. Practice with it here, or use the HDSAT Desmos Lab page.

resources.title: Desmos API documentation
resources.description: How the embeddable calculator API works, including the options HDSAT's Desmos Lab uses.

resources.title: Printable SAT practice tests
resources.description: Downloadable full-length practice tests with answer keys and scoring guides. Each math module reproduces the reference sheet the digital test provides.

resources.title: OpenStax College Algebra 2e
resources.description: Peer-reviewed open textbook, CC BY 4.0. Chapters 2, 5 and 7 map closely onto the Algebra and Advanced Math domains.

resources.title: OpenStax Statistics
resources.description: CC BY 4.0 coverage of data displays, probability and inference for the Problem-Solving and Data Analysis domain.

resources.title: OpenStax Writing Guide with Handbook
resources.description: CC BY 4.0 guidance on argument, evidence and revision for the Reading and Writing section.

resources.title: Purdue OWL: grammar and punctuation
resources.description: Clear reference pages on sentence boundaries, pronoun agreement, modifiers and verb forms for Standard English Conventions.

resources.title: Purdue OWL: using evidence and citation
resources.description: How to integrate evidence into an argument, useful for Information and Ideas and Expression of Ideas questions.

resources.title: Khan Academy: Grammar
resources.description: Video and practice sequence for the conventions tested in the Writing portion of the digital Reading and Writing module.

resources.title: Khan Academy: Statistics and probability
resources.description: Interactive units on scatterplots, two-way tables, probability and sampling.

resources.title: Khan Academy: Algebra 2
resources.description: Sequences, polynomial and rational functions, exponentials, logarithms and trigonometry.

resources.title: Wolfram MathWorld
resources.description: Reliable definitions and identities when a formula reference sheet is not enough.

resources.title: College Board: SAT fee waivers and test-day policies
resources.description: Official registration, accommodation and fee-waiver information so practice planning matches real test logistics.

resources.title: College Board: full-length practice tests
resources.description: Official hub for full-length practice, with free downloadable paper tests plus scoring guides and answer explanations. The digital versions run in Bluebook.

resources.title: College Board: testing accommodations
resources.description: How approved accommodations are arranged for the SAT and PSAT, and what documentation the school submits. Worth reading before registration, not after.

resources.title: BigFuture: college and career planning
resources.description: Free planning tools for college lists, scholarships, majors and careers. Useful once scores are moving and the next question is where to apply.

resources.title: Khan Academy: SAT Math
resources.description: The math half of the official SAT course, split by domain so a missed skill can be drilled on its own: algebra, advanced math, problem solving and data analysis.

resources.title: Khan Academy: SAT Reading and Writing
resources.description: The reading and writing half of the official course: comprehension, evidence, rhetoric and Standard English conventions, with passage practice.

resources.title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e
resources.description: Free online textbook that covers functions, equations and trigonometry with worked examples. A deeper reference when a single explanation is not enough.

resources.title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1
resources.description: Free limits, derivatives and integration textbook. Beyond the SAT itself, but it is the natural next step for a student who finishes the algebra strand early.

resources.title: OpenStax Biology 2e
resources.description: Free introductory biology text with clear expository prose. Long-form science reading is the cheapest way to raise reading stamina on dense passages.

resources.title: OpenStax Chemistry 2e
resources.description: Free general chemistry text with worked examples and end-of-chapter exercises. Good practice for quantitative reasoning inside a science context.

resources.title: OpenStax College Physics 2e
resources.description: Free algebra-based physics text. The word problems are close cousins of SAT math in the wild: rate, unit and proportional reasoning under a real context.

resources.title: OpenStax U.S. History
resources.description: Free chronological U.S. history text with primary-source excerpts. Useful background for the history and social-science passages the reading section draws on.

resources.title: LibreTexts Mathematics
resources.description: Open library of mathematics textbooks and course notes, searchable by topic. Every shelf states its own licence, so check it before reusing anything.

resources.title: UNC Writing Center: tips and tools
resources.provider: UNC at Chapel Hill Writing Center
resources.description: Short public handouts on thesis statements, evidence, revision and sentence-level clarity. Written for university students, still readable in ten minutes.

resources.title: Purplemath: algebra lessons
resources.description: Plain-language algebra lessons that name the mistakes students actually make, with worked examples for each technique. Good for a stuck afternoon.

resources.title: Math is Fun: algebra
resources.description: Visual, unhurried explanations of equations, exponents, polynomials and functions. The fastest way to rebuild a shaky foundation without a textbook.

resources.title: Paul's Online Math Notes
resources.description: Free algebra, trigonometry and calculus notes with fully worked practice problems and solutions. Dense, but the examples are the point.

resources.title: Desmos Scientific Calculator
resources.description: The non-graphing calculator for fractions, exponents, logs and trigonometry. Same engine family as the in-test calculator, so the keys feel familiar.

resources.title: GeoGebra Calculator Suite
resources.description: Graphing, algebra, geometry and table views in one free workspace. Handy for seeing why two forms of the same function behave differently.

resources.title: Wolfram|Alpha
resources.description: Computational engine for checking a result or seeing a problem solved step by step. Free for basic queries; use it to verify, not to skip the work.

resources.title: Anki: spaced-repetition flashcards
resources.description: Free desktop and Android flashcard app that schedules reviews by recall strength. Pairs with the vocabulary deck already inside HDSAT.

resources.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e
resources.description: A free, peer-reviewed first algebra course: linear equations, graphing, systems, polynomials and factoring, with worked examples and exercises throughout.

resources.title: OpenStax Precalculus 2e
resources.description: Functions, trigonometry, sequences and analytic geometry at the level just above the SAT Math section, useful for reading what a hard question is built on.

resources.title: OpenStax Introductory Statistics 2e
resources.description: The statistics behind the SAT's data questions: distributions, sampling, probability and how to read a study's claim.

resources.title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 2
resources.description: Not SAT content, but the clearest free treatment of series and integration for a student who wants to go past the test.

resources.title: MIT OpenCourseWare: Single Variable Calculus
resources.description: Full MIT lectures, notes, problem sets and exams, free and without registration. A stretch goal rather than SAT revision.

resources.title: MIT OpenCourseWare: Linear Algebra
resources.description: Strang's lectures and problems. Systems of equations seen properly, which sharpens the SAT treatment of them.

resources.title: Mathplanet: Pre-Algebra
resources.description: Short lessons with examples and video on integers, fractions, ratios and percentages: the arithmetic the SAT assumes rather than tests.

resources.title: Mathplanet: Algebra 1
resources.description: A full Algebra 1 course: equations, inequalities, functions, exponents and polynomials, in the order a school year covers them.

resources.title: Mathplanet: Algebra 2
resources.description: Quadratics, logarithms, sequences and probability, explained in short pages with worked examples.

resources.title: Mathplanet: Geometry
resources.description: Angles, triangle congruence, similarity, circles, area and volume, with diagrams: the geometry the SAT asks about indirectly.

resources.title: Kuta Software: free worksheets
resources.description: Printable practice worksheets with answer keys on algebra, geometry and trigonometry. Useful for paper drilling away from a screen.

resources.title: Open Textbook Library
resources.description: A searchable catalogue of hundreds of peer-reviewed open textbooks, including maths, statistics and writing, free to read and download.

resources.title: Purdue OWL: General Writing
resources.description: The hub for clear-sentence advice: structure, paragraphs, concision, punctuation and common errors, from a university writing centre.

resources.title: Purdue OWL: Commas
resources.description: Exactly when a comma is required, optional or wrong, with examples. The SAT's Boundaries questions are largely this page.

resources.title: Purdue OWL: Conciseness
resources.description: How to cut a sentence to its point without losing meaning: the skill behind most improved-sentence questions.

resources.title: Purdue OWL: Transitions and transitional devices
resources.description: A classified list of connectives with the logic each one signals: contrast, addition, cause, sequence. Direct help with Transitions items.

resources.title: Yale Poorvu Center: Writing
resources.description: Short guides on argument, evidence, thesis statements and revision from Yale's writing centre.

resources.title: UNC Writing Center: Evidence
resources.description: What counts as evidence in an argument and how to present it, which is what Command of Evidence questions are asking about.

resources.title: Project Gutenberg
resources.description: Over 70,000 free public-domain books, readable in the browser. Long-form reading practice that costs nothing and needs no account.

resources.title: Poetry Foundation
resources.description: Poems, biographies and criticism, free. Good practice for the density and figurative language of the SAT's literary passages.

resources.title: CommonLit: Text Library
resources.description: A free library of short nonfiction and literary texts with comprehension questions, searchable by year and topic.

resources.title: College Board: Bluebook practice tests
resources.description: The official adaptive practice tests in Bluebook, the same app the real digital SAT runs in. Six full tests are free.

resources.title: College Board: SAT test dates and deadlines
resources.description: Registration windows and score-release dates, including the waitlist option, for planning a study schedule backwards from a test day.

resources.title: College Board: what's on the SAT
resources.description: The authoritative section and domain list for the digital SAT, with the skill descriptions the questions are written against.

resources.title: BigFuture: plan for college
resources.description: College search, majors and application planning. Free, with optional sign-in for saved lists.

resources.title: GeoGebra Geometry
resources.description: A free geometry workspace for constructing and measuring figures, which makes circle and triangle questions concrete.

resources.title: The Learning Scientists
resources.description: Evidence-based study techniques (retrieval practice, spacing, interleaving) with downloadable summaries. Explains why a review schedule works.

resources.title: Math is Fun: Geometry
resources.description: Plain-language geometry with diagrams and small interactive illustrations: angles, circles, area, volume and the Pythagorean theorem.

resources.title: Paul's Online Math Notes: Algebra
resources.description: Complete algebra notes with worked examples and practice problems, written for students who want the full derivation rather than a shortcut.

resources.title: Desmos 3D
resources.description: A free 3D graphing tool for visualising surfaces and planes; useful for making volume and coordinate questions concrete.

resources.title: Practice and Preparation: the official hub
resources.description: One page that links every official practice tool: Bluebook tests, the question bank and score review.

resources.title: Download the Bluebook testing app
resources.description: The app used for official practice tests and for the digital test itself. Install it early.
